agents/curator.md.title: You propose removals. You never make them.

agents/graph-analyst.md.title: You analyse the graph and never modify the vault.

commands/aliases.md.title: Find pages whose acronyms, alternate spellings or common names are not in `aliases`. Missing aliases are the main reason a vault grows two pages for one thing.

commands/archive.md.title: Propose pages to move to `archive/`: still on disk and searchable, out of the index and the graph. Reversible, and nothing linked.

commands/ask.md.title: Answer $ARGUMENTS from vault pages only. Cite every page. Name what the vault does not cover.

commands/audit.md.title: Read `log.md` and the git history for the period in $ARGUMENTS. Report what ran, what it changed, and anything that changed without a log entry.

commands/backfill.md.title: Backfill $ARGUMENTS. Triage first, oldest first, ten per batch, checkpoint and stop between batches.

commands/bridges.md.title: Compute betweenness and list the pages connecting otherwise separate clusters. Say what stops informing what if each one is wrong.

commands/changed-my-mind.md.title: Trace revised positions for $ARGUMENTS, or the whole vault. Both positions, both dates, and what moved them.

commands/claude-md.md.title: Interview the user one question at a time, then write CLAUDE.md at the vault root: who they are, goals with dates, how to talk to them, projects, and the vault's own rules.

commands/clusters.md.title: Identify clusters and name them. Compare against what the user thinks their interests are, if that is recorded.

commands/commit.md.title: Stage the vault, write a commit message naming what changed and which run produced it, and report the diff summary.

commands/commitments.md.title: List commitments recorded in $ARGUMENTS with owners, and flag any with no clear next step.

commands/compare.md.title: Compare the two things in $ARGUMENTS using only what the vault records. Say which comparison points are unsupported.

commands/connect.md.title: Find how the two things in $ARGUMENTS connect in the vault. Show the path through pages, not just the endpoints.

commands/contradictions.md.title: Find every page recording a contradiction that is still open. For each: both positions, both sources with dates, and what would settle it.

commands/contradicts.md.title: Find everything in the vault that argues against $ARGUMENTS. If nothing does, say so plainly rather than manufacturing an objection.

commands/decisions.md.title: List the decisions recorded for $ARGUMENTS, with dates and what each rests on.

commands/dedupe.md.title: Scan $ARGUMENTS, or the whole wiki, for near-duplicates by title, alias overlap and shared inbound links. Propose merges with reasoning. Merge nothing.

commands/doctor.md.title: Verify the vault structure, CLAUDE.md, skills, git state and MCP connection if configured. Report what is missing or misconfigured.

commands/draft.md.title: Draft $ARGUMENTS from vault pages. First pass only, to be rewritten in the user's voice. Never introduce a number with no source page behind it.

commands/dry-run.md.title: Do $ARGUMENTS as a dry run: list every page you would create, update or delete, and every link you would add. Write nothing.

commands/explain.md.title: Ask the user to explain $ARGUMENTS from memory, then compare what they said against their page and name what was left out.

commands/export.md.title: Export $ARGUMENTS to `output/` in the requested format, rewriting links to unpublished pages as plain text.

commands/gaps.md.title: Read the pages on $ARGUMENTS and list the questions they raise that no source in the vault answers.

commands/graph-export.md.title: Run `scripts/graph_export.py` for $ARGUMENTS, defaulting to CSV edges, and summarise what the export contains.

commands/graph.md.title: Full graph report: the four metrics, hubs, bridges, clusters, and what each means for retrieval.

commands/handoff.md.title: Write a brief for someone picking up $ARGUMENTS cold: goal, state, decisions and why, open questions, where things live.

commands/health.md.title: The four metrics with a one-line verdict on each. No repairs.

commands/hubs.md.title: List pages with outsized inbound degree. For each, say which distinct ideas people are actually linking to, and propose a split.

commands/index.md.title: Rebuild `index.md` from the actual contents of `wiki/`. Group by type and theme, one line of description per entry, gaps at the bottom.

commands/ingest-chats.md.title: Triage the export at $ARGUMENTS. Privacy pass first, then the three piles, then ingest only what is approved.

commands/ingest-highlights.md.title: Ingest the highlights in $ARGUMENTS as one source page per book, then build concept pages from the ideas rather than the quotes. Keep quotes short and cited.

commands/ingest-mine.md.title: Ingest $ARGUMENTS as a source authored by the user: their positions, stated clearly, at a date. This is what makes the next piece in a domain faster.

commands/ingest-newsletter.md.title: Group the newsletters in $ARGUMENTS by topic first. One source page per actual item, citing every newsletter that covered it. Never treat repetition across newsletters as confirmation.

commands/ingest-pdf.md.title: Extract text from $ARGUMENTS, check the extraction quality before going further, and ingest. Scanned documents need OCR first. Screenshot any figure that carries the argument into `raw/assets/`.

commands/ingest-url.md.title: Fetch $ARGUMENTS, save the readable content to `raw/` with frontmatter recording the URL, author and date, then ingest it. If the page is a paywall notice or a fragment, say so instead of ingesting.

commands/ingest-voice.md.title: Transcribe and clean $ARGUMENTS, then extract the actual idea as a concept page in the user's own words. Drop false starts and repetition, keep the recording date.

commands/ingest-youtube.md.title: Pull the transcript for $ARGUMENTS into `raw/`, clean it with `second-brain-transcript`, then ingest. Split by topic first if the recording covers more than one.

commands/ingest.md.title: Process uningested sources in `raw/`. $ARGUMENTS is an optional path; with none, take everything without a source page, oldest first. Stop and report if more than twenty are pending.

commands/init.md.title: Create the vault structure: raw, wiki with its four page-type folders, projects, output, index.md, log.md, and a CLAUDE.md drafted by interviewing the user.

commands/know.md.title: Everything the vault holds on $ARGUMENTS: the concepts, the sources behind them, and where the sources disagree.

commands/link.md.title: Read the pages in $ARGUMENTS, or recently added pages if empty, and add links in both directions where the relationship is real. Create no pages, rewrite no content.

commands/lint.md.title: Full structural audit of $ARGUMENTS, or the whole vault. Fix mechanical problems, propose anything needing judgement, log the run.

commands/merge.md.title: Merge the pages named in $ARGUMENTS following the full procedure: survivor, claims, aliases, inbound links, log entry.

commands/metrics.md.title: Append this month's numbers to the metrics note and compare against the last entry.

commands/monthly.md.title: Metrics with trend, stale concept pages, the gaps list, and one structural thing to fix.

commands/orphans.md.title: List pages with no inbound links. For each, either propose where it should be linked from, or flag it as a deletion candidate.

commands/outline.md.title: Outline $ARGUMENTS from the vault. Every point tied to a page, disagreements surfaced, weak points marked.

commands/privacy.md.title: Full privacy audit: credentials, other people's information, confidential material, repo visibility. Report by severity. Delete nothing.

commands/project-status.md.title: Read the project in $ARGUMENTS and report: goal, what is done, what is in progress, what is blocked, and what has gone stale.

commands/project.md.title: Set up the project in $ARGUMENTS: four folders, a project CLAUDE.md with one measurable goal, and links to the concept pages it depends on.

commands/prune.md.title: Find concept pages with one source and no inbound links after a year, and stubs that never got filled. Propose removals with reasoning. Delete nothing.

commands/publish.md.title: Audit the opt-in set. Links to unpublished pages, flagged content, frontmatter to strip. Report only; do not build.

commands/quiz.md.title: Generate questions from the pages on $ARGUMENTS. Withhold answers until attempted, then grade against the pages.

commands/rename.md.title: Rename as specified in $ARGUMENTS. File, frontmatter, alias, every inbound link, log entry, then verify.

commands/report.md.title: Report on $ARGUMENTS. Scope against the vault first, name the gaps before writing, cite pages, state what could not be established.

commands/retype.md.title: Check whether $ARGUMENTS is filed as the right page type, and rewrite it to that type's contract if not. A source page that explains an idea is a concept page in the wrong folder.

commands/review.md.title: Review the period in $ARGUMENTS, defaulting to seven days.

commands/rollback.md.title: Show what the last run changed, then revert it on confirmation. Record the rollback in `log.md`.

commands/schedule.md.title: Propose a schedule for ingest, link, lint and review with the right cadence for this vault's volume, and the exact prompt for each task.

commands/schema.md.title: Validate frontmatter across $ARGUMENTS, or the whole wiki. Report missing required fields, wrong types, malformed dates and tags outside the vocabulary. Fix the mechanical ones.

commands/scope.md.title: Find the concept pages relevant to the project in $ARGUMENTS and save a briefing into its `Inputs/`, so work can continue with the vault scoped down.

commands/secrets.md.title: Scan the vault and `.obsidian/` for keys, tokens and passwords. Name the file and the type, never the value.

commands/sources.md.title: For the claim in $ARGUMENTS, list every source page behind it with dates and confidence labels. Say whether any of it is self-reported.

commands/split.md.title: Read $ARGUMENTS. If it holds more than one idea, propose the split points and the resulting page titles. Split only on approval, preserving inbound links to the original.

commands/stale.md.title: List concept pages whose `updated` date is older than ninety days, sorted oldest first, with how many sources arrived on their topic since.

commands/tags.md.title: List every tag in use with its count. Flag tags used once, near-synonyms, and anything not in the vocabulary in CLAUDE.md. Propose a consolidation.

commands/timeline.md.title: Order the vault's sources on $ARGUMENTS by date and show how the claims changed.

commands/trace.md.title: Answer $ARGUMENTS, then list every page read, in the order opened, with what each contributed.

commands/typed-links.md.title: Review the links in $ARGUMENTS and add types (supports, contradicts, extends, part-of, applies) only where the source states the relationship. Never infer a type.

commands/weekly.md.title: Last seven days: what was added, where attention went, what is unresolved, three things to do next.
